name: Hiseki Shinki Arcana Saber
original_name: 秘蹟神姫アルカナセイバー
source:
Arcana Cards.... A group of 22 cards that include great magical power.... Yukino is just an average girl. But one day, she accidentally receives one of the card called Wheel of Fortune. She is led by inescapable fate and gradually gets involved in a battle against Reversed....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
Arcana Cards…由二十二张蕴含强大魔力的卡牌组成…雪乃只是个普通女孩，可某天，她意外获得其中一张名为"命运之轮"的卡牌。在无可逃避的命运引导下，她逐渐卷入与Reversed之间的战斗…

[摘自ErogeShop]
